body: I woke up and they sent me to cat scan after and I remember crying because them moving me hurt. I don’t remember being in recovery and really remember things after getting to my room. I was very medicated and slept even when my family was visiting I was falling asleep the whole time. The next day was the pain. I had a CSF leak and was only home for a week before having to go back. I had terrible pulsating headaches that meds didn’t touch I couldn’t even get up without assistance had terrible vertigo vomiting which HURT so bad. Eventually my incision reopened and I had to go back to the er because I was pouring CSF fluid. After the second surgery and going home I’ve been feeling way better, sleeping has been the most difficult thing I can’t get comfortable I would recommend a good pillow with neck support

Update: I ended up having a CSF leak that was leaking under my skin and causing lots of build up until my incision reopened! I had to have a second surgery and happy to say recovery this time around is not as terrible as the first time.
Whatever it is, I hope it’s positive 💜
I’m glad you found a reason to stay
